observeCheckpoint(options) is first bounded filesystem observation layer, NOT parser/prefix/supervisor/orchestrator. TrustedleaderReapedboolean false=>not_observed BEFORE directory/ordinal/readBytes/path access (otheroptions intentionallydeferred). True=>ordinal1/2,readBytesboolean,absolute realnonsymlink currentUID0700dir/nofollow+nonblock availability checks; setup/config/dir errors throw fixed CHECKPOINT_OBSERVATION_INVALID distinctfromfile failures. Caller establishes actualreaping/nonescaping/no concurrentwriter/nonhostileimmutableancestry. Flag/pins are not lifecycle/buildattestation; futureorchestrator must checksourcepins separately.
Only fixed01-capital.json/02-unknown.json; O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK,regular/currentUID/singlelink. OpenENOENT=>absent, otheropen/file/stat/read/closeerrors=>present_invalid/nobytes. Directorydisappearanceafterchecks mayalsoENOENT underexcludedancestrymutation. Filemode stable butnotrequired0600inside0700dir.
readBytestrue: earlysizecap262144; fixedcap+1buffer/readloop; fullcount/size/prepostsamedescriptor dev/ino/mode/uid/nlink/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs stability; boundedcopiedrawBuffer present, noJSON/UTF8validation/digest/semanticclaim. finallycloseonce; closefailure overrides success withpresent_invalid/no partialbytes. RawBuffer mutableephemeral, neverpublicreport. No writes/deletes/globs/retries.
readBytesfalse: regular/UID/linkmetadataonly thenclose, ZEROreadSync=>present_unread, no cap/byte-stability/validityclaim. present_unread and not_observed deliberately NOT directQ17descriptors; futureadaptermust explicitlyhandle and metadataonlymap onlyafterbrokenprefix. No implementedprefixorchestration/verifierfailurepolicy yet; Q17O1/O2 gates retained.
16authored groups via python -B data/W015-Q18-checkpoint-observation-v1/run-tests.py pass0skip93.53731ms;246Pythonpass14.695s; Node25.2.1/Linux only. Harness createsownFIFO. Tests rawbytes/no mutation/fixedordinals/missing/empty/cap/links/FIFO/gate/config/metadatazeroreads/controlledread+stat+size+closefailures/actualappend/earlyoversize; actualproducercompatibility withQ17 calledexplicitlyBY TEST, notimplementation. Limitedprobes/notexhaustiverace/ownership/OSproof. Inspectsource/tests first; relevantofflineprobes allowed, no externalcode/network/liveModelClient/models/backendHTTP/Convex/Docker/cache/preflight/sharededits.
Deliver immutable exact_checkpoint_observation_increment_review accept/revise/unresolved withexactbindings/findings/checkedscope/probes/actualNEWTaskUUID aftermutualassent; separate recipientassessment required/no oldTaskextension.
